name: Eureka Forbes Ltd
tagline: Category-leading water-purifier/vacuum brand (Aquaguard) in a slow, still-unprofitable turnaround under Advent (PE) ownership; ~10-15% grower on a ~4% ROE, priced at ~50x earnings, with the promoter's near-entire stake now pledged
business_overview: Eureka Forbes is India's market leader in water purifiers (Aquaguard, ~45% share) and vacuum cleaners (Forbes/Euroclean, ~60% share), plus a growing air-purification and robotics line and a large AMC/service installed base. Following a change of promoter to Advent International (a PE firm), CEO Pratik Pota (ex-Jubilant) has been running an operational turnaround since ~2023. FY26 revenue Rs 2,710 Cr, PAT Rs 162 Cr; management aspires to Rs 5,400-5,600 Cr revenue and Rs 800-850 Cr EBITDA by FY30 (double revenue, triple EBITDA vs FY25).
fundamentals_table: Revenue Rs 2,710 Cr, PAT Rs 162 Cr, EBITDA margin ~9.5-10%
Operating co almost debt-free; no dividend despite profits
fundamentals_narrative: Earlier drafts of this file carried a badly overstated growth picture (60.93% YoY revenue / 160% 5-yr profit CAGR) that does not survive the filings. FY26 actuals: revenue Rs 2,710 Cr (~10% YoY), PAT Rs 162 Cr, EBITDA margin ~9.5-10%. Q1 FY27 revenue +15.3% to Rs 701 Cr, PAT Rs 55.4 Cr (+44%, but aided by a ~Rs 19.5 Cr exceptional/gratuity-reversal item) and adjusted EBITDA margin actually down ~46 bps to 10.5% standalone / 9.9% consolidated. Trailing return ratios are genuinely weak (ROE ~4%, ROCE ~5-6%) and have not inflected. The stock trades near 50x trailing earnings, so a slow, still-low-return turnaround is already priced richly. Management's FY30 aspiration (double revenue, triple EBITDA off FY25) implies ~15% revenue and ~25% EBITDA CAGR for four more years, which Q1 FY27's flat-to-down margin does not yet corroborate.

bse_notes: No SEBI/regulatory action found. In August 2026 promoters (Advent) pledged ~62.55% of the company's shares — essentially their entire ~62.6% holding — against a ~USD 92m debt refinancing. This is an escalation of the earlier ~54% pledge and, while explained as standard PE-sponsor capital-structure management (leverage at the sponsor, not distress at the operating company), it leaves the promoter stake almost fully encumbered. Company pays no dividend despite reporting profits.
bull_case: Genuine category leadership in two large categories (Aquaguard ~45% water-purifier share, ~60% vacuum-cleaner share), a strong consumer brand, and a large AMC/service installed base; low water-purifier penetration + rising water/air-quality awareness is a real structural tailwind
Steady mid-teens topline: Q1 FY27 revenue +15.3% with market-share gains in water purifiers and traction in newer categories (air purifiers, robotics); AMC bookings growing double-digit
Near-debt-free at the operating-company level; professional management (CEO Pratik Pota) with a stated FY30 plan to double revenue and triple EBITDA
Trusted-user conviction from harsh.beria93 citing the category-leadership thesis directly
bear_case: Turnaround has not reached the return line: ROE ~4%, ROCE ~5-6%, unchanged; Q1 FY27 adjusted EBITDA margin actually fell ~46 bps YoY and the PAT jump leaned on a ~Rs 19.5 Cr exceptional item
Valuation already rich: ~50x trailing earnings / ~30x EV-EBITDA for a ~10-15% grower on single-digit returns — the turnaround is priced as if it has already worked

Promoter pledge escalated to ~62.55% of shares (essentially the entire promoter stake) in Aug 2026 for a USD 92m refinancing; promoter has also trimmed its holding over time and the company pays no dividend

FY30 aspiration (double revenue / triple EBITDA off FY25) implies ~25% EBITDA CAGR that current-quarter margins do not yet support; execution risk is high and the guidance is aspiration, not a dated commitment
This project's older 108-stock research flagged Eureka Forbes ('excluded_large') as 'down-trending'; the dedicated VP company thread is very thin (8 posts) with no sustained multi-quarter diligence
verdict_headline: A real brand and category leadership, but a slow, still-unprofitable turnaround priced at ~50x with the promoter stake almost fully pledged — the 10x case does not hold once the real growth numbers are used
verdict_reasoning: Pass-1 deep read corrected the fundamentals: FY26 revenue grew ~10% (not the ~61% previously in this file) and profit CAGR is nowhere near 160%; ROE/ROCE remain ~4% / ~5-6% with no inflection, and Q1 FY27 margins fell YoY.

Four-box re-scored to 2.0 (tailwind yes; moat yes via Aquaguard brand + service base; tam NO — a 10x from ~Rs 8,050 Cr needs ~Rs 80,000 Cr and management itself only targets doubling revenue by FY30; valuation NO — ~50x trailing on a single-digit-ROE business). Score 2.0 with no written exception (valuation box not yes, growth not un-ignorable, not a large-cap named inflection) => thesis_fit 'neither', per the decision table.

The Aug-2026 escalation of the promoter pledge to ~62.55% of shares (the whole promoter stake) is a genuine governance/balance-sheet caveat; even read as normal PE-sponsor leverage it keeps conviction low.

Conviction held at Low: weak trailing profitability, rich multiple, aspirational (not committed) FY30 targets, near-full promoter pledge, and thin community coverage. Revisit if ROE/ROCE show a sustained move toward mid-teens and the pledge is unwound.
red_flag_reason: Near-entire promoter stake (~62.55% of shares) pledged as of Aug 2026 for a USD 92m refinancing — recorded as a named concern, not a formal AVOID/EXCLUDE/HIGH-CAUTION tier because it is disclosed PE-sponsor leverage rather than operating-company distress or a promoter-holding collapse.
